BREAKING: Los Angeles Clippers PUNISHED For Kawhi Leonard Contract, What It Means For Phoenix Suns

Stephen PridGeon-Garner
September 2, 2026
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 0:57
Instaread

The Phoenix Suns, along with other teams in the Pacific Division, will be direct beneficiaries of one less team being as competitive as it can be, with news of the NBA’s reprimand of the Los Angeles Clippers, Steve Ballmer, and Kawhi Leonard.

What clippers debacle means to devin booker, phoenix suns

In a division that, for the most part, has been fairly competitive with each other in head-to-head matchups as well as jousting for position in the standings come end of the season, this news will likely weigh heavily on the Clippers, as they set sail to navigate the many challenges posed by the league to them. How much does it all pertain to the Suns? How do the Suns, in specific, benefit from this? How does it all project going forward regarding the Pacific Division, standings, etc.?

Espo and Stephen PridGeon-Garner are back with a Wednesday episode of PHNX Suns, diving into that, plus much, much more!

0:00 – Intro

2:00 – LOS ANGELES CLIPPERS PUNISHED FOR SALARY CAP CIRCUMVENTION

21:20 – What This Means For The Phoenix Suns

43:30 – What This Means For The Western Conference

53:30 – Salute To Pablo Torre 🫡

Which Phoenix Suns Prospects Are PRIMED for a BREAKOUT Season?

Stephen PridGeon-Garner
September 1, 2026

The Phoenix Suns, starting with Khaman Maluach, have begun the process of stockpiling young talents, with great intention.

Phoenix suns crown jewels, including khaman maluach

That process has now started to show a return on investment. As the Suns challenge the likes of Maluach, Rasheer Fleming, Koby Brea, and Koa Peat, in addition to Oso Ighodaro and Ryan Dunn, there will be a certain type of spotlight on said players as more opportunity is extended their respective ways.

Who’s primed to be up to the task? Are there any clear-cut candidates to ascend? Are there any that we just dont see it with this season? As we heard from G-League Valley Suns head coach Paul Jesperson, there certainly is challenge and adversity in development; however, they’ve established an “attack it,” mindset with intent in their skill development program.

Espo and Stephen are back with a Tuesday edition of PHNX Suns to speak through that + plenty more!

0:00 – Intro

4:00 – Diving Deeper Into The Suns Depth Chart

5:15 – Why Jalen Green Isn’t Considered a “Young Player” In This Conversation

25:20 – Is Ryan Dunn Ready To BREAK OUT?

37:00 – Will Khaman Maluach TAKE THE LEAP?

44:40 – Is Rasheer Fleming The MOST LIKELY Sun To Breakout?

48:00 – Can Koa Peat STEAL Minutes His Rookie Year?
